item.title: GitOps, in 90 seconds: from `git push` to live
item.description: A walk-through of a real GitOps deploy flow — git push → GitHub Actions → ECR → ArgoCD Image Updater → ArgoCD sync. The flow is the easy part. The two-repo separation, sync waves, and failure modes are what make it stick.
